subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw land a partial text-only separator repair for the common case, or require a complete boundary-semantics design before merging this PR?
rationale: The bug and correct shared layer are clear, but the PR discussion and source path show text-only chunks cannot preserve the near-maxChars separator without a maintainer choice about delivery bounds, boundary metadata, or accepting a documented partial repair.
